input_variables.ticket_body:
Hi team,

I hope you are well. I wanted to write in about something that has been bothering our whole organisation for the last two days. We rely on TeamChat for all internal communication across our offices in Lisbon, Toronto and Singapore. Since Tuesday morning, messages sent in TeamChat arrive anywhere between 10 and 40 minutes late for everyone in the company. Some people have started using email again as a workaround, which is causing confusion because half of each conversation is in one place and half in another. We restarted our browsers, cleared caches and tried both the desktop app and the web version, with the same result. The status page says all systems are operational. Occasionally the desktop app also shows error E-7731 in the corner before reconnecting. This affects roughly 600 people and our managers are getting frustrated. Could you please look into it as soon as possible?

Best regards,
Maria
